fieldValues.title: Generated minutes carried no context, and other records blended it into what the meeting said
fieldValues.summary: An audit of thirty generated minutes found none attributing a remark to a named person and one naming a rule the meeting never mentioned, but no minute carried context; four of eight subject standings wrote standing rules into the same sentences as the meeting's own words.
evidence: Audit 2026-11-27 of two November runs: 1 of 30 minutes cites a standing record; 4 of 8 standings do, unmarked
No standing record id is spoken anywhere in the transcript
fieldValues.body: Guidance kept words out of mouths; it gave context nowhere to go. The rule needs two fields, not better wording.
